title: Kasinka Trading v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Kasinka Trading v. Union of India, (1995) 1 SCC 274
content.facts: Import-duty exemption was withdrawn and the withdrawal was challenged on promissory-estoppel grounds.
questionsBeforeCourt: Can promissory estoppel prevent withdrawal of a governmental exemption when public interest requires change?
content.ratioDecidendi: Promissory estoppel does not prevent government from withdrawing a representation where overriding public interest and the applicable legal framework justify the change.
content.holding: The Court upheld withdrawal in the circumstances.
content.relevance: Use for limitations and public-interest exceptions.
